## Repo Domains

The Repo Domains section helps manage code review responsibilities. Each domain represents a different aspect of the repository, so that pull requests are routed to the right reviewers.

This project is currently maintained by a single team, and the maintainers listed above own all domains of the repository:

```
*                @rbshaffer @aaronchafetz @avena-cms
```

As the project grows, ownership can be split by domain — for example, separating the Eleventy site templates (`_includes/`, `index.njk`), the dashboard front-end (`assets/`, `src/`), and the build and deployment configuration (`config/`, `.github/workflows/`) — and assigned to GitHub teams rather than individuals so that a single handle notifies every relevant reviewer.

> **Note:** This file documents ownership; it is not enforced by GitHub. GitHub only applies automatic review assignment from a file named exactly `CODEOWNERS` (no extension) located in the repository root, `.github/`, or `docs/`.
